sources.entry: QLMarkdown - Quick Look extension for Markdown files. - ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]

summary.one_liner: QLMarkdown is a macOS Quick Look extension that previews Markdown and related files (rmd, mdx, qmd, apib, textbundle, mermaid) with formatted HTML, plus a CLI and experimental Shortcuts commands for converting Markdown to HTML.
summary.what_it_does: The app renders Markdown files in macOS Quick Look using the cmark-gfm parser with many added extensions, including tables, task lists, footnotes, emoji shortcodes, math via MathJax, Mermaid diagrams, syntax highlighting, wikilinks, GitHub alerts, hashtags, YAML headers, and a table-of-contents sidebar. Output is styled with selectable CSS themes that adapt to light and dark appearance. Local images can be inlined so they show in the Quick Look preview. A companion qlmarkdown_cli tool batch-converts Markdown files to HTML, and two experimental Shortcuts commands format or save converted HTML. A settings window lets users configure options and test rendering on a file.
use_cases: preview Markdown files in Finder with Quick Look
preview rmarkdown, Quarto, or MDX files on macOS
batch convert Markdown files to HTML from the terminal
render Mermaid diagrams or math formulas in a Markdown preview
convert Markdown to HTML in Apple Shortcuts
customize the look of Markdown previews with CSS themes
how_to_run: Launch QLMarkdown.app at least once so the Quick Look extension is registered
notable: Quick Look preview plus a CLI and Shortcuts commands from one app
Inlines local images into the HTML so Quick Look can display them
Content Security Policy blocks untrusted JavaScript in generated HTML
Math and Mermaid can be loaded from a CDN or embedded in the output
Supports GitHub alerts, MkDocs admonitions, wikilinks, and hashtags beyond standard cmark-gfm
caveats: Not intended as a standalone Markdown editor or viewer; double-clicking files does not open it
Shortcuts commands are marked experimental, and the CLI does not share settings with the app or Quick Look extension
Provided as is without warranty; macOS may not honor the custom Quick Look window size, and the README warns about use on macOS before version 12
